title: Teacup Tower
description: Pick uncovered tea-house tiles off a layered pile, match three in a seven-slot tray and clear three rising towers.
controls: Tap a bright, uncovered tile to move it to the tray. Three alike clear. Undo and Shuffle can each be used once per level.

zh-CN.title: 茶盏叠叠
zh-CN.description: 从层层叠放的茶点牌里点出没被压住的牌，托盘凑齐三个相同就消除，清空三座越来越高的茶楼。
zh-CN.controls: 点亮色、没被压住的牌放进托盘，三个相同自动消除；托盘 7 格装满即失败。每关可撤回、洗牌各一次。
